_what: The Workshop modules the sites import (Ethos through workshop/…, trillion-x-school), found by reading each site's origin imports. A site bundles these, and a bundle has no folder of its own beside it, so a run-time read of a file from the module's own folder fails there. test/bundled-site-modules-read-no-file-beside-them.test.mjs reads this list. Extend the list when a site starts importing another module. allowed names a listed module that reads beside itself on purpose, with why.

allowed.why: Loads the formula engine's wasm with readFileSync(new URL(import.meta.resolve(...))): a binary package asset that a JSON import cannot carry. A site's bundler must ship the .wasm beside its bundle; the formula-engine owner holds that fix. Not a read beside the module's own folder, but the same bundle risk, so it stays visible here until that fix lands.
